input_domain: Sealed generated PDF 1.7 with independently pinned PDF/IR/plan digests, physical page count and the existing en-US expectation
known_issues: Checks only Info keys/values, catalog language, document-level controlled XMP, MarkInfo and StructTreeRoot type; not general PDF sanitization or all metadata channels.
Catalog tag prerequisites do not validate semantic tag trees, complete per-page tagging, reading order, alternate text, fonts or full PDF/UA conformance.
The existing validators parse the candidate separately; parser and XML initialization can allocate before post-parse structure checks. Mandatory process limits remain necessary.
Unsigned metadata and hashes do not authenticate a job, generating source or transferable execution attestation.
Whole-file effective-object safety, all-page text/raster coverage, scientific/source equivalence, aggregate resources and release remain separately gated.
Only the already activated en-US profile is admitted. No language, default pipeline, schema or report-delivery activation occurs.
Existing default 32-page/8-MiB routes and optional 512-page/8-MiB classes remain unchanged. Expanded synthetic page-tree fixtures are not qualification of fully tagged long reports.

process_profile.protocol_storage: two distinct anonymous owned regular file descriptors
